Black Friday sales are starting up in earnest including several Apple deals that have already gone live today. If you're hunting for a pair of AirPods this holiday season, your way is already over. Amazon has just dropped the price of the AirPods Pro 3 - Apple's best earbuds - to just $179 with free shipping. This is the lowest price ever for Apple's newest generation AirPods Pro and it still currently sells for $249 new at the Apple Store.

AirPods Pro 3 Noise Canceling Earbuds for $179 (Normally $249)

The AirPods Pro 3 launched late last year and is currently still the newest generation AirPods Pro. Like its predecessor, this is easily the best earbuds for anyone who uses an iPhone. Although it looks pretty similar to the 2nd gen AirPods, there are some pretty significant improvements under the hood. The most notable new feature is the built-in heart rate sensing (which means you may not need an Apple Watch anymore), but the AirPods Pro 3 improves in other subtle ways as well, including better audio quality, better noise cancelation, long battery life, and a more weatherproof IP57 shell.

Released alongside the AirPods Pro 3 was Apple's "Live Translation", which is an Apple Intelligence feature that translates other languages on the fly. First-hand user experiences have been positive, including this take from PCMag.
